title: Daily Routines: Word Order
description: Arrange shuffled words and expressions to build correct sentences about daily habits and routines.

items.sentence: I always wake up at seven in the morning.
items.translation: Eu sempre acordo às sete da manhã.

items.sentence: She drinks a cup of coffee before work.
items.translation: Ela bebe uma xícara de café antes do trabalho.

items.sentence: They usually eat lunch together at noon.
items.translation: Eles normalmente almoçam juntos ao meio-dia.

items.sentence: He brushes his teeth after every meal.
items.translation: Ele escova os dentes após cada refeição.

items.sentence: We walk the dog in the park every afternoon.
items.translation: Nós passeamos com o cachorro no parque toda tarde.

items.sentence: My brother goes to bed at ten o'clock.
items.translation: Meu irmão vai para a cama às dez horas.
